#: This gets merged into every version as #/local.
The zeroth element of this is always null since there is no version 0.

ident.title: Identification
ident.description: Identification string to be used when submitting the log message.

facility.title: Facility
facility.description: The syslog facility to be used when the log entry is submitted.
facility.x-description-append: Valid valies are kern, user, mail, daemon, auth, lpr, news, uucp, cron, syslog, local0, local1, local2, local3, local4, local5, local6 and local7.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: The syslog priority to be used when the log entry is submitted.
priority.x-description append: Valid values are emerg, alert, crit, err, warning, notice, info and debug.
